svg.data-weight-note: 21 lb (9.52 kg) chassis; each fan module 0.26 lb (0.12 kg); each 650 W AC power supply 2.42 lb (1.1 kg), no weight given for the other supplies
svg.data-altitude: 0 to 4000 m (0 to 13,123 ft), the specifications table
svg.data-optics-sfp28: guide: "48 100M/1/10/25-Gigabit Ethernet SFP28 ports (ports 1-48)". Auto-negotiation is not supported at 10G on ports 1 to 48 and on ports 49 to 52 with a QSA. SFP-10G-T-X and SFP-10G-OLT20-X are supported on a stated pattern of ports, with the neighbours limited to passive copper.
svg.data-timing: 1PPS and 10MHz SMB ports, a GPS/GNSS SMA antenna port and a ToD RJ-45 port. The guide says PTP grandmaster function is supported beginning with NX-OS release 10.3(2)F.
svg.data-regulatory: Products should comply with CEMarkings according to directives 2004/108/EC and 2006/95/EC.
svg.data-safety: CAN/CSA-C22.2 No. 60950-1 Second Edition, CAN/CSA-C22.2 No. 62368-1-19 Third Edition, ANSI/UL 60950-1 Second edition, IEC 62368-1, EN 62368-1, AS/NZS 62368-1, GB4943
svg.data-emissions: 47CFR Part 15 (CFR 47) Class A, AS/NZS CISPR22 Class A, CISPR22 Class A, EN55022 Class A, ICES003 Class A, VCCI Class A, EN61000-3-2, EN61000-3-3, KN22 Class A, CNS13438 Class A
svg.data-rohs: The product is RoH-6 compliant with exceptions for leaded-ball grid-array (BGA) balls and lead press-fit connectors.
